# Finlight

Search Finlight's financial news, retrieve articles by link, and list source metadata through its complete v2 REST API surface.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/finlight/.

## Actions

- **Get Article by Link** (read-only): Retrieve one Finlight-indexed article by its original URL.
- **List Sources** (read-only): List all news source domains visible to the connected Finlight account, including default-source status, origin country, and supported…
- **Search Articles** (read-only): Search Finlight's indexed financial news using text, market, source, geography, category, language, and date filters.
